description: Session begins. Rhea the Wizard enters the Forgotten Library of Ashenmoor, searching for the lost Codex of Ashenmoor.
outcome: Scene established. Rhea is at the entrance of the library. A rune-sealed iron door is visible at the far end. Whispers echo from the shelves.

description: Rhea casts the Light cantrip on her wand to illuminate the library interior and dispel the shadowed corners between the shelves.
outcome: Wand tip ignites with a warm white radiance, illuminating a 20-foot radius clearly and pushing dim light out to 40 feet. The dark corners between the shelves are now fully visible.

description: Session begins. Rhea the Wizard enters the Forgotten Library of Ashenmoor — a crumbling ancient vault beneath a ruined tower filled with bioluminescent moss, whispering shelves, and a rune-sealed iron door at the far end.
outcome: Scene established. Player character Rhea introduced. Awaiting player action.

description: Session begins. Rhea the Wizard enters the Forgotten Library of Ashenmoor. Scene initialized with glowing sealed iron door, whispering shelves, and bioluminescent moss lighting.
outcome: Scene is set. Rhea is in the Forgotten Library. Character sheet initialized. Awaiting player action.

description: Rhea casts Detect Magic (concentration, 10 minutes) upon entering the Forgotten Library of Ashenmoor. She examines the sealed iron door's rune, the whispering shelves, and any enchanted tomes for magical auras.
outcome: Detect Magic is active. Rhea perceives three distinct magical auras: (1) The rune on the iron door radiates powerful Abjuration magic — a ward of great age and craft. (2) The whispers originate from the bookshelves themselves — a faint Enchantment aura, ambient and old, like a recording left behind. (3) One tome on a nearby shelf glows with a dim Divination aura, standing out among the mundane books.

description: Rhea uses Detect Magic (still active) and Arcana proficiency to examine the tome of Elyas for traps or additional magical properties before opening it. Arcana check: 1d20+5 = 10.
outcome: DC 10 — Partial success. Rhea confirms the tome is not trapped. The Divination aura is intrinsic to the book itself — it IS a magical object, likely self-updating or prophetically inscribed. She cannot determine its full nature without opening it. The cover bears no ward. Safe to open.

description: Rhea casts Detect Magic (Level 1 spell slot) and makes an Arcana check (1d20+4) to analyze the magical auras in the Forgotten Library. She also listens carefully to the whispers drifting between the shelves.
outcome: Arcana check result: 14. Detect Magic active. Awaiting DM ruling on what magical auras and whisper details are revealed.
